title: Molecular Learning Workspace
description: A free, browser-based workspace for teaching computer-aided drug design (CADD). Users enter a molecule as SMILES, by name through PubChem, or from an example set, view its 2D structure, calculate physicochemical descriptors (molecular weight, Crippen LogP, TPSA, hydrogen-bond donors and acceptors, rotatable bonds, heavy atoms, rings, fraction sp3 carbon) and check Lipinski's rule of five and Veber's rules. Many molecules can be compared at once from a pasted list or CSV and exported as CSV. Built with Streamlit and RDKit.
